title: Cluster topology, node pools and the sandbox node pool
design_ref: The sandbox node pool and pod hardening
purpose: Show the EKS mode and version, the dedicated tainted sandbox pool, the instance type it runs on, the separate subnets and security group, the minimal node role, and that nothing but sandboxes runs on those nodes.

steps.display: kubectl describe pod taint-probe | grep -A3 Events
steps.output:
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age   From                   Message
  ----     ------            ----  ----                   -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  14s   default-scheduler      0/2 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector, 1 node(s) had untolerated taint(s). preemption: 0/2 nodes are available: 2 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.
  Warning  FailedScheduling  13s   eks-auto-mode/compute  Failed to schedule pod, did not tolerate taint (taint=CriticalAddonsOnly:NoSchedule); did not tolerate taint (taint=workload=sandbox:NoSchedule); incompatible requirements, label "workload" does not have known values

checks.description: a sandbox node exists and is labelled for Nitro Sandboxes
checks.because: Auto Mode launched a sandbox-capable node from the dedicated pool and labelled it.

checks.description: the pool taints its nodes workload=sandbox:NoSchedule
checks.because: The NodePool template carries the taint, so only pods that tolerate it can land there.

checks.description: the node sits in a subnet tagged tier=sandbox
checks.because: The sandbox NodeClass selects subnets by the ds01/tier=sandbox tag, so these nodes cannot be placed in the platform subnets.

checks.description: the node uses the dedicated sandbox security group
checks.because: The NodeClass pins the security group created for sandbox nodes.

checks.description: IMDSv2 is required and Nitro Enclaves are enabled
checks.because: Auto Mode launches nodes with IMDSv2 required; Nitro Sandboxes need the Enclaves option, which Auto Mode set.

checks.description: the sandbox node role has only the two minimal managed policies and no inline policy
checks.because: Terraform attaches exactly these two policies. There is no S3, Secrets Manager or other access an escaped process could use.

checks.description: only the sandboxes namespace has pods on the sandbox node
checks.because: Nothing else tolerates the sandbox taint, so platform pods and the controller run on the general-purpose pool.

checks.description: an ordinary pod that asks for the sandbox pool stays Pending
checks.because: The scheduler refuses it because it does not tolerate the workload=sandbox taint.
